description: This file contains utility functions and interrupt vector handlers for managing MPU (Memory Protection Unit) and fault handling in an STM32F4-based embedded system. It includes functions for stack checking, hardware initialization, fault diagnostics, and SPI peripheral setup.

methods.name: prvGetRegistersFromStack
methods.description: Collects register contents from the stack at the time of a fault for postmortem analysis.

methods.name: getRemainingStack
methods.description: Calculates the remaining stack space in thread contexts for debugging purposes.

methods.name: baseHardwareInit
methods.description: Initializes hardware components, including resetting cycle counter and setting supply brown-out reset level.

methods.name: _unhandled_exception
methods.description: Handles unhandled exceptions by triggering a panic.

methods.name: DebugMonitorVector
methods.description: Handles debug monitor exceptions, triggers panic.

methods.name: UsageFaultVector
methods.description: Handles usage faults, triggers panic.

methods.name: BusFaultVector
methods.description: Handles bus faults, triggers panic.

methods.name: HardFaultVector
methods.description: Handles hard faults, parses fault info, and triggers panic if critical.

methods.name: isSpiInitialized
methods.description: Array tracking SPI initialization status for multiple SPI peripherals.

methods.name: getSpiAf
methods.description: Returns the alternate function number for a given SPI driver.

methods.name: getMisoPin
methods.description: Returns the MISO pin for a given SPI device.

methods.name: getMosiPin
methods.description: Returns the MOSI pin for a given SPI device.

methods.name: getSckPin
methods.description: Returns the SCK pin for a given SPI device.

methods.name: turnOnSpi
methods.description: Initializes and enables SPI for a specified device.

methods.name: initSpiModule
methods.description: Configures the SPI hardware and GPIOs for a specific SPI module.

methods.name: initSpiCs
methods.description: Configures the chip select GPIO for SPI communication.

methods.name: BOR_Get
methods.description: Reads the brown-out reset level from the flash option bytes.

methods.name: BOR_Set
methods.description: Sets the brown-out reset level via flash option bytes.

methods.name: isValidCan1RxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN1 receiver.

methods.name: isValidCan1TxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN1 transmitter.

methods.name: isValidCan2RxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN2 receiver.

methods.name: isValidCan2TxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN2 transmitter.

methods.name: isValidCanTxPin
methods.description: Determines if a pin is valid for CAN transmission (either CAN1 or CAN2).

methods.name: isValidCanRxPin
methods.description: Determines if a pin is valid for CAN reception (either CAN1 or CAN2).

methods.name: detectCanDevice
methods.description: Detects and returns the appropriate CAN driver instance based on pin pairs.
